create_solvent_from_atoms: create a Solvent instance by passing an ase.Atoms object representing a solvent molecule
create_solvent_from_db: create a Solvent instance by passing a solvent_id_from_db index to load from the solvent database
get_molecules_per_volume: get the number of molecules per angstrom cubed from the Solvent molecules_per_volume property
get_solvent_length: get the number of atoms in a Solvent instance using len() on the object
get_solvent_name: get the solvent name as a string using str() on the Solvent instance
